elements.text:
Theme	Core sub-themes	Illustrative quote	Meaning for operations
Fragmented recordkeeping creates no single source of truth	Manual and hybrid recording; person-dependent updates; informal workarounds.	"So far, we do not have a system for tracking our sales and inventory..." (Interviewee 1)	Operations depend on scattered records rather than a unified live record.
Delayed updates make the accurate picture arrive too late	Unposted movement; next-day correction; decisions made under uncertainty.	"The deeper issue is that the real situation becomes visible too late." (Interviewee 3)	Even when the truth is eventually reconstructed, it often arrives after the decision window.
Inaccurate records disrupt service, fulfillment, and restocking	Customer promise failure; partial release; conservative or delayed restocking.	"This can disappoint customers and reduce sales." (Interviewee 2)	Weak records quickly become visible as stockouts, delays, and missed sales.
